note: One plain-language template per status. Slots: {{areas}}, {{detail}}, {{situation}}. Do not put the agency's verbatim answer in these templates. That text belongs in Answer relied on.

C1.Impact: Yes: Rights are affected. The output can reach {{areas}}.
C1.Impact: No: Rights are not affected. The answers do not name a rights area.

C2.Impact: Yes: Safety is affected. The output can reach {{areas}}.
C2.Impact: No: Safety is not affected. The answers do not name a safety area.

C3.Impact: Yes: Benefits or public services are affected.
C3.Impact: No: Benefits or public services are not affected. The answers do not name that area.

C4.Met: Staff keep the decision. The output recommends or informs, and a person reviews it before it takes effect.
C4.Partial: The decision role or the review is only partly in place. {{detail}}
C4.Gap: The output can take effect without the review this criterion requires, or the decision role is not determined. {{detail}}

C5.Met: Every named group has a path that fits it, including language access where that group is named.
C5.Partial: At least one named group does not have a fitting path. {{detail}}
C5.Gap: Groups who need extra care are not identified, or a practice shuts a group out. {{detail}}

C6.Met: Bias testing is in place. Results are tested on a population like Maryland's, and outcomes across groups are checked on a schedule.
C6.Partial: Bias testing is incomplete or only planned. {{detail}}
C6.Gap: Bias testing is absent or not determined. {{detail}}

C7.Partial: Notice that AI is involved is incomplete. {{detail}}
C7.Gap: Notice that AI is involved is absent or not determined. {{detail}}

phrases.no_outside: No one outside the agency is affected, so a separate public notice is not required.
phrases.in_place: People are told that AI is involved where they meet the decision or contact. Notice is in place.

C8.Partial: The path to a person or a challenge is incomplete. {{detail}}
C8.Gap: A path to a person or a way to challenge a result is absent or not determined. {{detail}}

phrases.no_outside: No one outside the agency is affected, so a public challenge path is not required.
phrases.in_place: People can reach a person and challenge a result, and a person can change the result.

C9.Met: Human oversight is in place. A person reviews outputs before they take effect, can change or stop the AI system, and overrides are recorded.
C9.Gap: Human oversight is absent or not determined. {{detail}}

C10.Met: Data protection for this level is in place, including access limits and any encryption or privacy review the level requires.
C10.Gap: Data protection is absent or not determined. {{detail}}

C11.Met: Accuracy testing and monitoring after launch are in place. Results are tested with set criteria and tracked against a threshold.
C11.Partial: Accuracy testing or monitoring after launch is incomplete. {{detail}}
C11.Gap: Accuracy testing or monitoring after launch is absent or not determined. {{detail}}

C12.Met: Accountability is in place. Named roles cover monitoring, incidents, and reassessment at least yearly.
C12.Gap: A named owner for incidents or reassessment is absent or not determined. {{detail}}

RP1.In place: Foreseeable misuse, how the AI system can fail, and who is harmed are described in writing. This recommended practice is in place.
RP1.Partly in place: The impact analysis is only partly written. {{detail}}
RP1.Not yet: An impact analysis is absent or not determined. {{detail}}
RP1.Not applicable: This recommended practice does not apply to this AI system.

RP2.In place: The contract splits responsibilities and requires notice of model changes and security incidents. A certificate alone does not make this in place.
RP2.Partly in place: Some contract terms are still draft, requested, or missing. {{detail}}
RP2.Not yet: The contract terms for responsibilities and notice are absent or not determined. {{detail}}
RP2.Not applicable: This check does not apply. The AI system is built by the State with no outside model or vendor.

RP3.In place: Data sources are recorded, quality is checked, and training or reference data is protected from tampering.
RP3.Partly in place: Source records, quality checks, or tamper protection are incomplete. {{detail}}
RP3.Not yet: Source records, quality checks, or tamper protection are absent or not determined. {{detail}}
RP3.Not applicable: This recommended practice does not apply to this AI system.

RP4.In place: Staff have written instructions and training, and a named role can change or stop the AI system.
RP4.Partly in place: Staff instructions or the power to stop the AI system are incomplete. {{detail}}
RP4.Not yet: Staff instructions or the power to stop the AI system are absent or not determined. {{detail}}
RP4.Not applicable: This recommended practice does not apply to this AI system.

RP5.In place: The applicable AI security threats are covered and security testing is recorded. Design facts are listed for any threat marked as not applying.
RP5.Partly in place: Threat coverage or security testing is incomplete. {{detail}}
RP5.Not yet: Threat coverage or security testing is absent or not determined. {{detail}}
RP5.Not applicable: This recommended practice does not apply to this AI system.

RP6.In place: Each use is logged, and a fixed test set is re-run on a schedule and after model updates.
RP6.Not yet: Logging or re-testing is absent or not determined. {{detail}}
RP6.Not applicable: This recommended practice does not apply to this AI system.

RP7.In place: A named role tells affected people about an incident, and staff have a concerns channel outside the team.
RP7.Partly in place: Incident notice or the staff concerns channel is incomplete. {{detail}}
RP7.Not yet: Incident notice or the staff concerns channel is absent or not determined. {{detail}}
RP7.Not applicable: This recommended practice does not apply to this AI system.

RP8.In place: A new model, new data, new tools, or a new use triggers a re-check, and retirement covers models, data, stores, and logs.
RP8.Partly in place: Re-check triggers or the retirement plan are incomplete. {{detail}}
RP8.Not yet: Re-check triggers or the retirement plan are absent or not determined. {{detail}}
RP8.Not applicable: This recommended practice does not apply to this AI system.
